recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片幾乎看不到脂肪，細胞密度接近100%，由一片片密集的顆粒球系細胞組成，左上可見骨小樑，整片視野中巨核細胞很少，符合aCML的高細胞性、顆粒球為主的骨髓。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow (near 100%) with virtually no residual fat
Diffuse sheets of granulocytic cells with small dark to irregular nuclei, consistent with maturing myeloid elements
Scattered eosinophilic cytoplasm among the myeloid cells; erythroid islands not prominent
Megakaryocytes are inconspicuous/decreased at this power
Bony trabecula at upper left; low magnification limits assessment of dysplasia and blasts
describe_en: Bone marrow trephine section at low power shows a markedly hypercellular marrow, approaching 100% cellularity, abutting a bony trabecula. The marrow space is filled by sheets of granulocytic cells, with relatively inconspicuous erythroid islands and few megakaryocytes in this field. No discrete fibrosis, lymphoid aggregates, or clusters of blasts are evident at this magnification. The findings are consistent with a granulocyte-predominant myeloproliferation; together with peripheral blood dysgranulopoiesis and absence of BCR::ABL1, they support atypical chronic myeloid leukemia.

ddx.vs: CML also produces a packed granulocytic marrow but typically with increased small hypolobated megakaryocytes and basophilia; BCR::ABL1 detection is required to separate them.
CNL shows mature neutrophil predominance without dysgranulopoiesis and with <10% circulating precursors, often with a CSF3R mutation.
CMML has absolute peripheral monocytosis ≥0.5–1×10^9/L with ≥10% monocytes, highlighted in the marrow by CD14/CD163 immunostains.
Reactive hyperplasia (infection, G-CSF) lacks dysplasia and clonal markers and is usually less extreme with preserved megakaryocytes and fat.
